description: This file defines the onboarding flow UI for an Android app built with Jetpack Compose. It includes multiple steps for setup, such as gateway connection, permission requests, and final verification. It manages user interactions, permission handling, gateway configuration, and displays status summaries and diagnostics.

classes.name: OnboardingStep
classes.description: Enumeration representing each step of the onboarding process.

classes.name: GatewayInputMode
classes.description: Enumeration for gateway input configuration modes.

classes.name: PermissionToggle
classes.description: Enumeration for various permission toggles in the permission step.

classes.name: SpecialAccessToggle
classes.description: Enumeration for special access toggles such as NotificationListener.

methods.name: canFinishOnboarding
methods.description: Determines if onboarding can be finished based on connectivity status.

methods.name: onboardingPrimaryButtonColors
methods.description: Defines colors for primary buttons in onboarding.

methods.name: onboardingTextFieldColors
methods.description: Defines colors for text fields in onboarding.

methods.name: onboardingSwitchColors
methods.description: Defines colors for switches in onboarding.

methods.name: StepRail
methods.description: Displays step progress indicators for onboarding.

methods.name: WelcomeStep
methods.description: Composable showing the welcome feature overview.

methods.name: GatewayStep
methods.description: Composable managing gateway connection configuration.

methods.name: GuideBlock
methods.description: UI component for displaying instructional blocks.

methods.name: GatewayModeToggle
methods.description: Component to select gateway input mode.

methods.name: GatewayModeChip
methods.description: Button chip for selecting gateway modes.

methods.name: QuickFillChip
methods.description: Quick fill options for host configuration.

methods.name: ResolvedEndpoint
methods.description: Display resolved gateway endpoint.

methods.name: StepShell
methods.description: Container for each onboarding step content.

methods.name: InlineDivider
methods.description: Horizontal divider UI element.

methods.name: PermissionsStep
methods.description: UI for selecting app permissions.

methods.name: PermissionSectionHeader
methods.description: Header for permission sections.

methods.name: PermissionToggleRow
methods.description: Row UI for toggling specific permissions.

methods.name: FinalStep
methods.description: Summary and review before completing onboarding.

methods.name: isPermissionGranted
methods.description: Checks if a specific permission is granted.

methods.name: qrScannerErrorMessage
methods.description: Returns error message when QR scanner fails.

methods.name: isNotificationListenerEnabled
methods.description: Checks if notification listener is enabled.

methods.name: openNotificationListenerSettings
methods.description: Opens the notification listener settings page.

methods.name: openAppSettings
methods.description: Opens the app's detail settings page.

methods.name: hasMotionCapabilities
methods.description: Checks for device motion sensor capabilities.
